name: contracts: reconcile evidence-core boundaries with concepts and product scaffolds

description.purpose: Draft contract for evidence-core a-foundation. Interchange definitions; not evidence of implemented Rust behavior.
description.limitations: Schema conformity and ODCS metadata do not authenticate Git sources, analyzer correctness, execution, security validity or completeness.

quality.name: source_and_evidence_identity
quality.description: Recompute canonical IDs, referenced input digests and source identities in Rust; ODCS alone does not establish integrity.

quality.name: independent_producer_acceptance
quality.description: Independently audit exact evidence and producer-specific scope before trusting any claim.

context.instructions: Never infer missing relationships as absence or convert self-hashed receipts into execution attestations. Feature acceptance needs independent Rust/native tests.

verifiedStatements.question: Does this metadata establish implementation?
verifiedStatements.answer: No. It documents a proposed wire shape; real behavior is not yet implemented or independently verified.

constraints.constraint: Do not convert a candidate, generic graph edge or review event into a stronger claim than the producer supplied.
Missing observations with incomplete coverage do not prove that relations are absent.
A self-consistent digest does not attest an independent tool execution or security impact.
